title: Three Gorges Dam
summary: The Three Gorges Dam crosses the Yangtze River in Hubei province, China. The US Geological Survey gives it as about 181 m tall and 2,335 m long, with the reservoir beginning to fill in June 2003 and the plant becoming the world's largest hydroelectric power plant in 2012. Sources differ on the start of construction, 1992 or 1994, and WorldAtlas says the dam body was finished in 2006.

uncertainty.note: Start differs by page: USGS says construction began in 1992, WorldAtlas says 1994. I used 1992 (USGS, government) with a 2-year plus range. WorldAtlas says the body was finished in 2006 and full operation came in 2012. End is the present: the dam operates.
